title: T-pillar design on the Gate of the Sun

tellings.quote: That's from the back of the sunate in tiwanaku bivia and it's the same concept of the three doorways

plain: A researcher named Matt told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2024 that the back of the Gate of the Sun, a carved stone gateway at Tiwanaku, an ancient site in Bolivia, shows a T-shaped pillar design with the same idea of three doorways that he sees elsewhere. If true, it would suggest a shared symbol linking ancient sites far apart from each other.
